CREATE TRIGGER file_search_fts_delete_content_after_trigger_v2 AFTER DELETE ON files_content_table BEGIN INSERT INTO file_search_fts_v2(docid, root_relative_file_path, title, artist, album, keyword) SELECT id, root_relative_file_path, title, (SELECT artist FROM files_metadata_table WHERE file_id = old.file_id), (SELECT album FROM files_metadata_table WHERE file_id = old.file_id), (SELECT * FROM (SELECT (SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(label, ' '), '') FROM file_label_table WHERE file_id = old.file_id) || ' ' || (SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(address, ' '), '') || ' ' || IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(device_description, ' '), '') FROM files_metadata_table WHERE file_id = old.file_id) AS keyword) WHERE keyword != '  ') FROM files_master_table WHERE id = old.file_id; END
